processed-line: - [ ] https://redhat.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/jobs/job/Dubai/Technical-Account-Manager---Openshift---Remote--Dubai-_R-054008-1 | Red Hat | Technical Account Manager - Openshift- (Remote, Dubai) | Dubai | posted: 2026-08-17
recommended-action: Do not apply. Core requirement is 5+ years enterprise-level expertise with OpenShift/Kubernetes/containers/Ansible and enterprise architecture; candidate (mid-level frontend/solutions developer) has zero container/platform/Linux infrastructure experience and no adjacent path to bridge it. Role is regionally anchored to Dubai with required regional travel; candidate is US-based (Raleigh, NC) with no UAE work authorization. Tech-stack, seniority, and geo mismatches are hard blockers.
